title: REQ · Single loadWorld with strict field validation
summary: loadWorld in loader.ts keeps the array scenes shape and gains world.ts's strict field and scene-id checks.
description: Context: loader.ts loadWorld casts YAML without checking fields, while world.ts checks string fields, mapping shape and scene id match. Desired behavior: the surviving loadWorld returns scenes as SceneDef[] and throws the stricter errors. Expected result: malformed world.yaml or scene files fail loudly in one place. Why: invalid content must be caught at load time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a world.yaml missing the id string field, when loadWorld runs, then it throws an error mentioning 'id'
Given world.yaml listing scene s2 with no scenes/s2.yaml, when loadWorld runs, then it throws an error mentioning s2.yaml
Given scenes/s.yaml declaring id other, when loadWorld runs for scene s, then it throws an error mentioning 'expected s'
Given valid files, when loadWorld runs, then scenes is an array containing the scene with id s
definition_of_done: loadWorld enforces field checks and returns scenes as an array
